There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner today on call.

Ms. V.L. Singh,
learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL for the respondent nos. 3 & 6; and Mr. N. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 4, 5, 7 & 8 are present.

Mr. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate has submitted, on the basis of the instructions received, that after passing of the award under Section 3G[1] of the National Highways Act, 1956,
the Competent Authority Land Acquisition [CALA] has received the requisite documents from the petitioner and after verification of the documents, the matter is being processed for disbursement of the compensation amount awarded to the petitioner.
As the learned counsel for the petitioner is found absent today, let the case be listed on 21.03.2025.
Mr. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate shall obtain up-to-date instructions on the next date of listing.
